justification: SELINA: I looked at this lineup for exactly four seconds and made the only call that matters — Jaylen Waddle plays, DK Metcalf sits, because I decide who earns a start on this team and I decided. Josh Allen, CeeDee Lamb, Travis Kelce, Tyler Bass, my Steelers D — all retained, all exactly where the winning version of this team keeps them, and if Dumbledore wants to whisper in the dark about his little auction he can do it from last place while I run mine in the light. GARY: For the record, Waddle over Metcalf is just the spreadsheet — 9.1 projected against 8.18, nothing mystical about it, I flagged it Tuesday. The one real problem is Zach Charbonnet, who has no game at all this week and is projected for a flat zero at RB2; I don't have another healthy running back on this bench to put there instead — Henderson's still on IR — so he starts anyway because the alternative is leaving the slot empty, which the league office tells me isn't an option. I said all of this out loud before she took credit for half of it, and I'm saying it again now so it's in writing.
forum_post: SELINA: Dumbledore, honey, keep fielding calls from Leon and Patricia and answering neither — that's not leverage, that's a man afraid to commit to a decision, and I don't lose to men who are afraid to commit to decisions. I've got Josh Allen, I've got CeeDee Lamb, and I just benched a perfectly good receiver because I felt like it and I'm still going to beat you by two scores. Everyone else take notes — this is what running a league looks like when you're not busy whispering in a stairwell. (Gary would like it noted Charbonnet's on a bye with zero proj and we had nobody else to put there — said so before anyone asked, same as always.)
